constraint_fidelity.evidence: Nearly every operator answer is followed. Shared TranslationInput is used (saleor.diff utils.py: `class TranslationInput(...): ... storage_conditions = graphene.String(`). categoryTranslate and collectionTranslate reject the field with INVALID (test: `assert data["errors"] == [{"code": "INVALID", "field": "storageConditions"}]`). Webhook and CSV export are covered (payloads.py `"storage_conditions",` in PRODUCT_FIELDS; csv/enums.py `STORAGE_CONDITIONS = "storage conditions"`). The 250-character limit is enforced. Values are stored as submitted and escaped on render (product-storage-conditions.test.ts: `escapes markup in the value`). The storefront shows it only inside the description area (product-attributes.tsx, inside the `value="description"` accordion). No Playwright tests were added. One operator answer is not followed: the operator said `A first-class nullable field on Product.`, but the migration makes the Product column non-nullable (0211_product_storage_conditions.py: `models.CharField(blank=True, default="", max_length=250)`), and product_cleaner.py says `# The column is not nullable; an explicit null clears the value.` So the API returns "" and never null. Two smaller deviations: (1) a change to the shared bulk-translate error code that affects every entity (utils.py: `-  code=e.code,` / `+  code=get_error_code_from_error(e),`); (2) an edit to the storefront product route (page.tsx `storageConditions={readStorageConditions(view.extensions)}`), although storefront-view.ts says `Do not edit src/lib/storefront/mappers/product.ts or the product route.`

assumptions: Product.storage_conditions is a non-null CharField with default "" instead of nullable; explicit null is turned into ""
Existing products get ""; no data migration beyond AddField
Editing needs MANAGE_PRODUCTS (existing product mutations), translating needs MANAGE_TRANSLATIONS, and the value can be read publicly, including by anonymous users
Stored per product, not per variant
The dashboard field is shown only on main-schema builds (@lockSchema / isMainSchema); staging builds hide it
The storefront trims the value and falls back to the base value when the translation is blank or whitespace
The storefront shows the value as a labelled line inside the description accordion, and the accordion now renders when only storage conditions exist
Bulk-translate error codes are normalised for all entities via get_error_code_from_error
productBulkCreate and the CreateProductDialog create flow also accept the field
The storefront product route is edited despite the fork's 'do not edit the product route' rule
